verdict.label: not_replicated
verdict.rationale: Both claims concern the association between milk intake and BMI z-score in children/adolescents, so the exposure, outcome and contrast are comparable. Source A (PMID 28799014) reports a significant negative association: 'Milk intake was negatively and significantly associated with BMI z-score (β = - 0.103, p < 0.001).' Source B (PMID 30638821) explicitly concludes no association after adjustment: 'milk (0.022 units; 95% CI -0.007 to 0.052; P=0.13) intakes were not associated with BMI z scores.' Since one source reports an effect and the other explicitly reports no association (an explicit substantive no-effect conclusion, not merely a nonsignificant same-sign estimate), the finding is not replicated. Extractions on both sides match their sources; the positive point estimate in B with an explicit no-association assertion is correctly captured.
